app.name: Wii DNS Switcher
app.short_description: Switch DNS on existing Wi-Fi connections
app.long_description: Saves named primary-DNS profiles on the SD card and applies them directly to the console's configured connections, without touching SSIDs, passwords, or other settings. Secondary DNS defaults to 1.1.1.1 unless set per profile. Port of the 3DS DNS Switcher, using the config.dat layout documented by the OfflineNetworkEnabler project.
